description: Scale a GUI sprite to N or WxH with the mcmeta stretch/tile/nine_slice mapping. Returns PNG bytes and/or the scaled PNG via an explicit output path; never invents filenames.

inputPath.description: Raster image or .mcpx path to scale as a GUI sprite.

mcmetaPath.description: Explicit .mcmeta path for the scaling section, used verbatim; omitted means stretch.

minecraftVersion.description: Release Minecraft version 1.19.3 through 26.3 (for example "1.19.3", "1.21.4", "26.3"). Omitted means engine defaults.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

resourcePackVersion.description: Target resource-pack version as N or N.M (e.g. 84, 97.1); normalized to major.minor. Omitted means engine defaults.

name: scale_gui_asset
